Mistress '''Gallger''' is the innkeeper of [[The Golden Wheel]] in [[Far Madding]]. She is lean with her hair in a dark bun on the back of her head.

She surveys the common room and looks suspiciously at [[Rand]] until he buys a drink, because she does not like her serving men and women talking when they should work.
